chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I contact the Admin or Zonal Superintendent directly?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: You can use the Live Chat tab in this widget! Select the Admin or Zonal Superintendent from the recipient list to send a direct WhatsApp-style message on this platform.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I create or submit a monthly report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: To create a report, log in to your Church or Zonal dashboard. Under "Start a New Report", select the Month and Year, then click "Create Report". Fill in all the financial receipts, attendance figures, and spiritual entries. Click "Save Draft" at any time to preserve your work, or "Submit Report" when it is ready to finalize.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How are dues calculated?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Dues such as National Dues, Regional Dues, District Dues, and Zonal Dues are automatically calculated based on your Subtotal Receipts (a-c) and the percentage rates set by the Admin. The rates differ for Chartered and Unchartered churches. You do not need to compute them manually — the system does it for you.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: Can I edit a report after submitting it?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Once a report is submitted it becomes locked and view-only. To make corrections, click the "🔓 Unlock & Edit" button on the report page. An unlock fee may apply. After unlocking, the report returns to Draft status and you can edit and re-submit it.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I contact the Admin or Zonal Superintendent?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Use the Live Chat tab inside this widget. Select the Admin or your Zonal Superintendent from the recipient list and type your message. They will receive it instantly on the platform.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What are the different types of financial receipts in the church report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
The Church Financial Report is divided into several receipt categories:
• (a) Tithes
• (b) Sunday Offerings
• (c) Building / Welfare Fund
• Subtotal (a-c) — used for due calculations
• Sunday School Offerings
• Missionary Offerings
• Love / Welfare Offerings
• 3rd Sunday Offerings
• Other special offerings

Each category is filled separately and the system totals them automatically.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the difference between Chartered and Unchartered churches?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: A Chartered Local Church is a fully established Foursquare church that has been officially chartered. An Unchartered Local Church is a new or developing church that has not yet received its charter. The distinction affects the due percentage rates applied to your receipts. Your church type is set at registration and can be updated by the Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I save a report as a draft?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: While filling in your monthly report, click the "Save Draft" button at any point. Your entries will be saved and you can return to complete the report at a later time. A report in Draft status is not yet submitted and can still be edited freely.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I download or print my report as PDF?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: After submitting or saving a report, open the report and click the "Download PDF" or "Print Report" button. The system will generate a formatted PDF of your complete monthly report which you can save or print for physical records.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What spiritual information do I fill in the church report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
The Spiritual Report section includes:
• Total attendance (adults, youths, children)
• New converts
• Baptisms (Water and Holy Spirit)
• Dedications
• Weddings
• Funerals / Burials
• Home cells / Outreaches
• Membership figures

All these figures help the zonal and national leadership track church growth.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How does the Zonal Report work?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: The Zonal Admin collects monthly financial and spiritual summaries from all churches under the zone. The zonal report consolidates these figures: total receipts, total dues, attendance across all branches, and other aggregated statistics. The Zone dashboard shows a breakdown per church and allows the Zonal Superintendent to review and submit the combined zonal report.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I register a new church on the portal?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Go to the Register Church page from the homepage. Fill in the Church Name, District, Church Type (Chartered or Unchartered), Church Address, and Pastor details. Then provide the administrator credentials (name, email, password). Once submitted you will receive a confirmation and can log in to your church dashboard.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I register a new zone on the portal?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Go to the Register Zone page from the homepage. Enter the Zone Name, list the churches under the zone (one per line), and provide the Zonal Secretary credentials. Once submitted, the zone is created with its church list and the Zonal Admin can log in immediately.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What happens if I enter wrong figures in my report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: If the report is still in Draft status, simply go back and correct the figures before submitting. If you have already submitted, you will need to unlock the report first using the "Unlock & Edit" button. After unlocking, edit the figures and re-submit.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I view past reports?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: From your Church or Zone dashboard, click on "Report History" or "View Past Reports". You can filter reports by month and year. Each report shows its status (Draft, Submitted, Locked) and can be opened for viewing or downloaded as PDF.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the Pastor Welfare due and how is it calculated?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Pastor's Welfare is a due deducted from the Subtotal Receipts (a-c). The percentage rate is set by the Admin for both Chartered and Unchartered churches. It is automatically calculated when you fill in your receipts — you do not need to enter it manually.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What does Subtotal (a-c) mean in the financial report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
Subtotal (a-c) is the sum of the three main receipt categories:
• (a) Tithes
• (b) Sunday Offerings
• (c) Building / Welfare Fund

This subtotal is the base amount used to calculate most of the church dues such as National Dues, District Dues, Zonal Dues, Pastor's Welfare, and others.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: Can multiple users use the same church account?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Each church has one administrator account (the Church Admin). That account is used to fill and submit the monthly reports. If you need to change the registered administrator, please contact the Zonal Superintendent or the platform Admin to update the account details.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the 3rd Sunday Offering and how is it reported?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: The 3rd Sunday Offering is a special offering collected specifically on the third Sunday of every month. It is reported separately in the financial receipts section of the Church Monthly Report. The full amount (100%) is remitted as due.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I reset or change my password?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: To change your password, log in and go to your Profile settings on the dashboard. If you have forgotten your password and cannot log in, please contact your Zonal Superintendent or the platform Admin via the Live Chat to have your credentials reset.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the Macpherson University due?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Macpherson University due is a percentage deducted from the Subtotal Receipts (a-c). It is a contribution by all Foursquare churches toward the development and running of Macpherson University. The rate is set centrally by the Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the FFS Savings due?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: FFS Savings (Foursquare Financial Services Savings) is a percentage deducted from the Subtotal Receipts (a-c). It is a savings contribution made by each church to the Foursquare Financial Services scheme. The rate is set by the Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the Augmentation Fund?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: The Augmentation Fund is a due deducted from the Subtotal Receipts (a-c). It is used to augment the welfare and remuneration of pastors within the district or zone. The percentage is set by the Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the Foursquare TV due?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Foursquare TV is a percentage contribution from the Subtotal Receipts (a-c) dedicated to supporting the Foursquare Gospel Church television ministry and media outreach. The rate is centrally set by the Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I update my church or zone information?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Church and Zone information such as address, pastor name, district, and church type can be updated from your dashboard under Profile or Settings. If you need to change critical details like the church name or type, contact the platform Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: Who can see my church reports?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Your submitted reports are visible to your Church Admin (you), your Zonal Superintendent, and the platform Super Admin. Reports are confidential and not shared outside the platform. The Zonal Admin sees an aggregated summary of all churches in the zone.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the Project Development Fund?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: The Project Development Fund is a due deducted from the Subtotal Receipts (a-c). It is used to fund infrastructure, property, and development projects within the Foursquare church organization. The percentage rate is set by the Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the Regional Fund due?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: The Regional Fund due is a percentage deducted from the Subtotal Receipts (a-c) and remitted to the Regional office. It supports regional administration and activities. The rate is set by the Admin.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I log out of the portal?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: To log out, click on your profile name or avatar on the top right corner of your dashboard, then select "Log Out". Your session will be ended securely. Always log out when using a shared device.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What happens once I submit a monthly church report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
When you click \'Submit Report\':
1. The report status changes from Draft to Submitted and is officially forwarded to District and National records.
2. An immutable frozen snapshot of all due rates, percentages, and lock statuses is sealed for permanent record integrity.
3. The report is locked against accidental modifications. If a critical correction is required afterwards, an Admin unlock request can be made.

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How do I download or print my report without showing website URLs or browser headers?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Click the \'🖨️ Print / Save as PDF\' button at the top of your report page. The portal uses custom print formatting that automatically removes all browser header dates, page numbers, and website URLs, giving you a clean, presentation-ready official church document.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: print, pdf, download, export, paper copy, remove url, clean print

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What are the official rules and guidelines for completing the Church Financial and Spiritual Report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
Here are the core rules for completing your monthly Church Financial and Spiritual Report:
1. **Subtotal (a–c) Foundation**: Tithes & Worship Offerings (General Tithe A + Minister\'s Tithe B + Worship Offerings C) form the base (Subtotal a–c) used for computing National, Regional, District, Zonal, and Seminary percentage dues.
2. **Dynamic Rates for Chartered vs. Unchartered Churches**: The National Headquarters (Super Admin) manages distinct percentage dues for Chartered and Unchartered assemblies. Any rate adjustments made by Admin immediately apply to newly created and draft reports.
3. **Locked Dues Rules**: Dues items locked by the Super Admin (e.g. certain pension contributions or love offerings) remain inactive (0.00) and cannot be calculated unless explicitly unlocked by Admin.
4. **Draft Auto-Saving**: You can click \'Save Draft\' at any time to save your progress. You can return to edit and complete your draft report before final submission.
5. **Staff Emoluments & Operating Payments**: Minister basic + allowances sum to Sub Total (Ministers); Other Workers basic + allowances sum to Sub Total (Other Workers). Together with all operating expenses and fixed assets, they automatically accumulate into SUB TOTAL (Fixed Assets).
6. **Total Payments & Reconciliation**: Total Payments = SUB TOTAL (Fixed Assets) + Dues Summary (Payables Total). The system automatically computes Balance Surplus/Deficit (Total Receipts - Total Payments) and rolls forward the balance with Last Month\'s closing figure.
7. **Submission is Final**: Once you click \'Submit Report\', the report is permanently locked and an immutable snapshot of all rates is sealed. To modify a submitted report, an unlock fee via Paystack is required.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: rules, guidelines, report rules, policy, chartered, unchartered, due rules, how to report, financial rules

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What are the rules for completing the Zonal Report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
The Zonal Report consolidates monthly returns from all member churches under the zone:
1. **Zonal Assemblies Integration**: The zonal report aggregates financial and spiritual metrics across the Zonal Headquarters and all branch churches in the zone.
2. **Direct Numerical Inputs**: Enter the exact remittances and returns submitted by each assembly under the zone.
3. **Automatic Reconciliations**: Total receipts, total remittances, and variances are automatically calculated on the zonal ledger.
4. **Submission**: Review all branch church entries before clicking \'Submit Zonal Report\'.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: zonal report, zone rules, zonal guidelines, zone report rules, zonal consolidation

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How does the AI Voice Report Assistant work on the portal?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
The AI Voice Assistant lets you complete your entire church or zonal report effortlessly without typing:
1. Click the \'🎙️ Voice Assistant\' button at the top of your report form to turn on voice recognition.
2. **Cursor Dictation Mode**: Click your cursor inside any input box (e.g. General Tithe, Minister Basic, Electricity, Pastor Name) and speak the number or words. The AI will instantly type it in for you.
3. **Spoken Locator Mode**: You can also simply speak the field name and amount (e.g. \'General Tithe 50000\', \'Minister Allowance 35000\') and the assistant will automatically scroll to, highlight, and fill that exact field.
4. Auto-calculated summary fields (such as Subtotals, National Dues percentages, and Balances) are automatically protected and calculated in real time.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: voice, voice assistant, dictation, ai voice, microphone, speak, voice typing, speech recognition

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What are the main rules and formulas for calculating church financial returns?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
The Church Financial Report follows standard National guidelines:
1. **Subtotal (a–c)**: Sum of General Tithes (A) + Minister\'s Tithe (B) + Worship Offerings (C). This forms the baseline for calculating percentage dues.
2. **Staff Emoluments**: Minister\'s Basic + Allowances sum to Subtotal (Ministers); Other Workers Basic + Allowances sum to Subtotal (Other Workers). Combined, they form Total Emoluments.
3. **Subtotal (Fixed Assets)**: Total Emoluments + General Operating Expenses + Fixed Assets items.
4. **Total Payments**: Subtotal Fixed Assets + Dues Summary (Payables Total).
5. **Balance Surplus/Deficit**: Total Receipts minus Total Payments. The current monthly balance is updated with last month\'s closing balance forward.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: calculation, formula, subtotal, emoluments, fixed assets, receipts, payments, surplus, deficit

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What is the difference between Chartered and Unchartered Church dues?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
1. **Chartered Churches**: Mature assemblies operating with established constitutions and full ministry departments. They contribute standard National, Regional, District, and Seminary percentage allocations.
2. **Unchartered Churches**: Developing branch assemblies and church plants. National Headquarters configures specific percentage relief or altered dues rates for unchartered assemblies.
3. The portal automatically applies the correct live percentage rates based on whether your church is designated as Chartered or Unchartered.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: chartered, unchartered, church type, difference, dues percentage, branch church

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: How does the Zonal Monthly Report work and what does it consolidate?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
The Zonal Report consolidates monthly metrics for all assemblies within the zone:
1. **Assemblies Included**: The Zonal Headquarters and all branch churches registered under the zone.
2. **Page 1**: Compares Spiritual Attendance and Financial Remittances between this month (T/M), last month (L/M), and a year ago. Includes Summary of Spiritual metrics and Church Planting Reports.
3. **Page 2 & 3**: Detailed bi-monthly comparative metrics and analysis.
4. **Auto-Calculations**: Totals, variances (%Diff), and summary aggregates are computed automatically across all member churches.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: zonal report, zone, consolidation, branch churches, spiritual comparison, remittance

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: Can I save my monthly report as a draft and finish it later?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: Yes! You can click \'Save Draft\' at any time while working on your Church or Zonal report. All entered numbers, expenses, and spiritual statistics are securely saved. When you return, you can continue right where you left off until you are ready for final submission.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: draft, save draft, continue later, resume report, edit draft, unfinished report

chatbot_knowledge_base.question: What spiritual metrics are reported in the church report?
chatbot_knowledge_base.answer:
The Spiritual Section records vital church growth indicators:
1. Total New Comers / First Timers
2. Decisions for Christ / Converts Won
3. Water Baptisms and Holy Spirit Baptisms
4. Testimonies of Divine Healing
5. Total House Fellowship / Cell Centres
6. Child Dedications, Weddings, and Funerals
7. Sunday School, Worship Service, and Prayer Meeting average attendance.
chatbot_knowledge_base.keywords: spiritual report, attendance, converts, baptism, new comers, healings, fellowship

chatbot_knowledge_base.answer: You can message your Zonal Superintendent or Super Admin directly on this portal by switching to the \'Live Chat\' tab in the chatbot widget, or by sending an in-app message from your dashboard.
